note: Read on 20 Nov 2026. The homepage is a one-page app (it calls itself the 'Corporate Website Rebuild' prototype); card routes are #/article/<slug> fragments of the homepage, so there is no detail page to fetch. Plain mode gets the 7 Credit Card-i menu entries under Cards (Debit Card-i is level 1 and is left out); the headless browser gives the same 7. Each card route only shows its Product Disclosure Sheet. window.SITE_DATA.docList, about 7.3 MB into the page, so only in the browser copy (plain reads stop at 5 MB), names the PDF: /PDS/Personal%20Banking/Cards/Credit%20Card-i/<folder>/PDS%20Credit%20Card-i%20-%20Eng.PDF. On 20 Nov 2026 all 7 PDFs were the same file (sha256 f24fdcb7..., 'Date: 1 June 2026'). robots.txt and sitemap.xml are 404; /portal-main/compare-cards is 404.
